name: Ted Cruz

lean.basis: Republican U.S. senator from Texas since 2013 and runner in the 2016 Republican presidential primary; a hawkish, pro-Israel conservative.

race_2028.basis: Openly laying groundwork for 2028 as a pro-interventionist Republican, courting pro-Israel and former Haley donors; Trump allies treat a run as all but certain, though he says he is focused on the midterms.

summary: Ted Cruz, Texas's solicitor general from 2003 to 2008, has represented Texas in the Senate since 2013 and finished second to Trump in the 2016 Republican primary. He hosts the Verdict podcast and is laying groundwork for a 2028 run as the hawkish alternative to JD Vance, feuding publicly with Tucker Carlson over foreign policy and Israel.
